NOTIFICATION UNDER SECTION 16 SUB –SECTIONS (2D) OF THE COASTCONSERVATION AND COASTAL RESOURCE MANAGEMENT ACT, No. 57 OF 1981
Proposed 34 Roomed Kalamatiya Cabana Hotel projectKalamatiya Road, Hathagala, HungamaEnvironmental Impact Assessment Report

IT is hereby notified that the Report of Environmental impact Assessment study on proposed 34 Roomed KalamatiyaCabana Hotel project at Kalamatiya Road, Hathagala, Hungama, submitted by the Mr. A.L.A.C. Rathnapala,No.383E,Wagapitiya, Balangoda as required by the Section 16 (1) of the Coast Conversation and coastal ResourceManagement Act, No.57 of 1981 as amended by the Act, No.64 of 1988 and No.49 of 2011 will be available for inspectionby the public at the following institutions from 8.30 a.m to 4.15 p.m for a period of 30 days from 26.08.2019.(Exceptweekends and public holidays)
In addition, this report with 03 languages can be used in the official web site (www.coastal.gov.lk) of the Department ofCoast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management.
(1) Coast Conservation & Coastal Resource Management Department ,New Secretariat building,4th floor ,Maligawatte, Colombo 10.
(2) Central Environmental Authority , No. 104, “Parisara Piyasa” Densil Kobbekaduwa Mawatha , Battaramulla.
(3) Department of Wildlife Conservation, No. 811/1, Jayanthipura Mawatha , Battaramulla.
(4) Divisional Secretariat, Ambalantota
